decisive_items: duodenal diverticula, wall thickening with mesenteric edema approximately 25 cm beyond the ligament of Treitz, and mesenteric lymphadenopathy with luminal patency
response.rationale: CT shows duodenal diverticula with wall thickening and mesenteric edema, plus lymphadenopathy, and follow-up resolution of inflammation, consistent with diverticulitis. R6 (lymphoma) lacks specific features and would not resolve spontaneously.

rejected.why: No chronic symptoms or typical IBD findings; family history alone insufficient.
Mesenteric panniculitis does not explain diverticula or wall thickening.
CT findings and duration not consistent with gastroenteritis.
